independentScoreHistory.method: I read the brief, the art bible (palette and rendering), the previous independentScore (71, build ac21f3b, identical to score-gear-shaft-v3.json) and the builder's rebake2-status.md, then re-checked each previous point. I weighted the engine shots first: all eight docs/verification/p5-rooms-gear-shaft-*.jpg used here (hero, hero.diffuse, both gear-turned variants, ring, void, seam-north), viewed in full, plus 2x Lanczos crops of the upper well (voidwell.png), the gear train (gears.png), the ring top, and the furnace in engine, lightmap-only and Cycles (furnace.png, furnace-diffuse.png, furnace-cycles.png). I used the review sheet, void.high.png and hero.reference-diffuse.png to separate bake faults from runtime ones. The missing flames and the peach fire are runtime faults, because the Cycles reference shows the flames and the lightmap-only frame keeps the fire at hue 34. The flat gilt is runtime too: the dielectric constant measures L* std 2.1 lightmap-only. My like-for-like benchmark was the study's re-shot engine.hero.png and engine.hero.diffuse.png from the same 1280x720 harness. Measurements used Pillow and numpy on fixed boxes, checked against an overlay image (overlay.png), and two boxes that missed their surface were corrected. Per box I measured mean RGB, HSV of the mean, CIELAB L* mean and std, Rec.709 luma mean, std and p95, and the share of the frame under L* 5 and 2. I used gilt masks (sat>0.3, v>0.45) with the shaft columns zeroed, and took the mean absolute difference between the normal and gear-turned frames per gear box. I verified the report.json files{} and provenance stagingFiles hashes against disk (all match), and read engine-compare.json and uv1-report.json. Scripts and crops are in /tmp/rxr-score-gs4/. I made no repo edits.
